content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Academic Qualification: Secondary; Valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) and Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) driving license Experience: Minimum of three (03) years of relevant driving experience Age limit: Maximum 25 years (as on 31 October 2026) Other conditions: Must be a citizen of India Must possess a valid LMV and HMV driving license Must be medically fit and free from any condition that may adversely affect safe operation of vehicles

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Wages at rates not less than the applicable minimum wages notified by the competent Government authority from time to time, paid by the Contractor/Service Provider by electronic bank transfer. Engaged through a Contractor/Service Provider on a purely contractual basis for 89 (eighty-nine) days Purely temporary; no right or claim to regular appointment, absorption, regularisation or continuation beyond the contract period Drivers remain employees of the Contractor/Service Provider, not regular employees of the Institute or Central Government Contract may be terminated by either party with fifteen (15) days' prior written notice Institute may terminate immediately for misconduct, rule violation, negligence or unsatisfactory performance, or at any time without reason

content_sections.text: Trade Test (Written) Skill Test for candidates who qualify in the Trade Test Skill Test only for candidates who qualify in the Trade Test

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: All certified copies of certificates and documents in support of the eligibility criteria Police verification certificate Medical fitness certificate issued by a Government Hospital

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report at the Transport & Automobile Section, IIT Kharagpur on 02-12-2026 at 09:00 AM. Submit certified copies of certificates and documents, police verification certificate and medical fitness certificate at the venue before the trade test. Do not send advance copies of applications.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Advance copies of applications are NOT to be sent Documents are to be submitted at the venue prior to the trade test EPF and ESI contributions are deposited by the Contractor/Service Provider Working hours are set by the Institute; a weekly day of rest is allowed as per labour laws Alcohol or drugs on duty, rash driving or traffic violations may lead to immediate removal

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 2 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 2 December 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Transport & Automobile Section, IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 25 years (as on 31 October 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Wages paid by the Contractor/Service Provider at rates not less than the applicable minimum wages notified by the competent Government authority, with EPF and ESI.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic Qualification: Secondary; valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) and Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) driving license; minimum three (03) years of relevant driving experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Must possess a valid LMV and HMV driving license. Must be medically fit and free from any condition that may adversely affect safe operation of vehicles.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Trade Test (Written). Skill Test for candidates who qualify in the Trade Test. Skill Test only for candidates who qualify in the Trade Test.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engaged through a Contractor/Service Provider on a purely contractual basis for 89 (eighty-nine) days. Purely temporary; no right or claim to regular appointment, absorption, regularisation or continuation beyond the contract period. Drivers remain employees of the Contractor/Service Provider, not regular employees of the Institute or Central Government.

faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur.
